title: AMD: How Chips Are Changing - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 73]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we’re breaking down a global semiconductor company known as AMD.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we’re breaking down a global semiconductor company known as AMD. AMD isn’t the biggest and hasn’t always been the best chip maker in the world. But as cyclical and structural changes take place in the semiconductor industry, AMD serves as a great proxy for what’s going on and why.

key_points.text: To break down the details, both behind the company and the industry, I’m joined by Jay Goldberg.
We explore the rise of custom silicon, AMD’s competition with Intel and Nvidia.
Please enjoy this breakdown of AMD.
